pet_notes: The latest user direction overrides ALL earlier art. Blank expression at all times, no matter what. State semantics must come only from posture, limbs and small body motion, never changing mouth, brows or emotional eyes. Hair is straight, no curls or waves. Straight apron/dress, no flared skirt and no cape. Preserve physical gaze through head and eye direction while maintaining blank face. Props stay attached. No actual watcher code runs in Pets.
style_notes: Use supplied woman and dark Alice references. Ink black and ivory monochrome gothic doll. Straightened shoulder-length black hair, blunt straight bangs, white headband. Fixed blank expression in EVERY state: flat neutral mouth, neutral brows and large dark unexpressive eyes. No smile, frown, shock or emotion at any time. Straight black knee-length dress and rectangular white apron/pinafore, white collar, white stockings and black flat shoes. No cape. Small attached black trick pouch at hip with silver key and ivory scroll. Compact full-body proportions with readable clean ink lines, not oversized baby head.
